description: This file contains utility functions for testing statistical features related to books, including creation, management, and calculation of ratings and reading metrics. It defines test data for various book scenarios and supports testing of book-related statistics.

classes.name: StatisticTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to populate, manage, and access test data related to book statistics for testing purposes.

methods.name: populateReadBooks
methods.description: Initializes test data with a set of sample books with various ratings, genres, and pages, marking some as read older books and some from the current year.

methods.name: addReadBook
methods.description: Resets and adds a single read book with predefined ratings, genre, and pages to the test dataset.

methods.name: createReadBook
methods.description: Creates a book marked as read with specified title, rating, genre, pages, and start date, and updates overall ratings.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Creates a Book object with provided details, including author, genre, pages, and start date, but does not save it.

methods.name: saveBook
methods.description: Saves the book using the bookService and adds it to internal tracking list.

methods.name: updateTotalRating
methods.description: Updates the cumulative total rating based on the provided rating scale.

methods.name: reduceTotalRating
methods.description: Reduces the cumulative total rating by the specified rating.

methods.name: updateThisYearRating
methods.description: Adds the rating to the rating sum for books read in the current year.

methods.name: getBookWithLowestRating
methods.description: Returns the book with the lowest rating in the test data.

methods.name: getBookWithHighestRating
methods.description: Returns the book with the highest rating in the test data.

methods.name: getBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Returns the book with the most pages.

methods.name: getBookWithLowestRatingThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the lowest rating published this year.

methods.name: getBookWithHighestRatingThisYear
methods.description: Returns the highest-rated book published this year.

methods.name: getNumberOfBooks
methods.description: Returns the total number of books in the test dataset.

methods.name: getNumberOfBooksThisYear
methods.description: Returns the number of books started this year.

methods.name: getTotalNumberOfPages
methods.description: Calculates total pages of all books in the dataset.

methods.name: deleteBook
methods.description: Deletes a specified book from the dataset and updates ratings accordingly.
